messages.content: Ran my 10k time trial this morning: 42:30, which is about 4:15 per km.
Strong run. 42:30 for 10k at 4:15 per km puts your critical speed estimate around 4:28 per km.
Good to know. What pace should my easy runs be now?
Easy runs at 5:20 to 5:35 per km. Keep them genuinely easy.
My goal is the city half marathon on 1998-10-04, hoping to run 1:32.
A 1:32 needs about 4:22 per km. Reachable from today's shape with a solid 10 week build.
My right achilles was sore for two weeks in May after I switched to zero-drop shoes.
Noted, that achilles flare in May tied to the zero-drop switch.
It settled once I went back to my Nike Pegasus shoes.
Good. Keep long runs and the race in the Pegasus for this cycle, no shoe experiments.
My calves cramped a little at 8k of the time trial too.
Let us add calf conditioning twice a week to address that cramping at 8k.
Weekly mileage is around 52km right now. How high should it go?
We will peak at 65km in week 7, then taper into the race.
Which day for the long run? Saturdays I do an easy parkrun with my daughter.
Sunday long runs then, and keep the Saturday parkrun easy.
What does this weekend's long run look like?
16k on Sunday with the last 4k at 4:40 per km.
Perfect, I will report back how the achilles feels after.
Please do. Any flare in the achilles or calves and we adjust.

facts.statement: right achilles sore two weeks in May from zero-drop shoes, resolved on Pegasus
weekly mileage 52km now, peak 65km in week 7
calf cramping at 8k, calf conditioning twice a week
Sunday long runs, Saturday easy parkrun
16k long run with the last 4k at 4:40 per km
